sources.snippet: Overview segmentation-3.0 is a neural speaker segmentation model maintained by pyannote that processes 10-second chunks of mono audio sampled at 16kHz and outputs a (num_frames, num_classes) matrix with 7 classes representing non-speech, individual speakers, and speaker overlaps.
